question.instructions: Would this shopper recommend the clothing item they reviewed? Focus on the overall sentiment: a 3-star review that mentions fit issues, defects, or returning the item is not_recommended. A 3-star review with mixed but net-positive sentiment (likes the item but has minor complaints) is recommended.

criteria.not_recommended: The reviewer expresses clear dissatisfaction, mentions returning the item, describes defects or major fit problems, or overall negative sentiment despite any positive mentions.
criteria.recommended: The reviewer expresses overall satisfaction, would buy it again, or has net-positive sentiment even with minor complaints.
